chapter_title_en: The Sleeping Sage of the Three Realms Palace
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 368 – The Three Realms Palace & Houyi’s Archery Art
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters the hidden Three Realms Palace, meets the legendary Jidian, and discovers the top-ten divine abilities, including the terrifying Houyi Archery Art. The trial of the Candle Dragon’s Eye awaits!
og_title: Inside Mount Innerheart’s Most Secret Library
og_description: Ji Ning steps into the Three Realms Palace—a vault of nineteen supreme techniques. From the easy-to-get Candle Dragon’s Eye to the impossible Houyi Archery Art, the power is real.
twitter_title: The Three Realms Palace Opens: Top-Teen Divine Abilities Await!
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s year of sword training pays off as he enters Subhuti’s hidden palace. The legendary Houyi Archery Art is just one shelf away.

lore_anchors.definition: The most secret location on Mount Innerheart, a pavilion containing nineteen supreme divine abilities, secret arts, and formation techniques gathered by Patriarch Subhuti. Only the most talented disciples ever gain entry.

Subhuti’s second disciple, a gaunt old man who sleeps constantly but roams the Three Realms via the Dream of the Three Realms. Accumulator of boundless karmic merit and legendary figure in countless minor worlds.
A supreme divine ability unique to Subhuti and Jidian that allows the user to send incarnations across all Three Realms while sleeping, perceiving everything simultaneously.
A top-one-hundred divine ability originally mastered by the primordial Fiendgod Candle Dragon; grants the user dragon-like vision that manipulates light and darkness.
A top-ten divine ability created by the True God Houyi. Unlike brute-force techniques like the Starseizing Hand, this is a technical school requiring deep comprehension and insight.
A top-ten divine ability by Daoist Threelives; focuses on refining the hands into weapons that can crush stars and rival Immortal-grade treasures.
A sword-art manual written by the Daofather Plowheart, obtained by Ji Ning from the Immortal Palace’s ninth floor.
The final manual glimpsed in this chapter; a high-tier cultivation technique whose nature is not yet revealed.
